title: 飛機地面振動試驗
summary: 以「用多點幅相和測試邊界辨識地面振動模態」為主線，在合成敲擊、激振與模態資料台中依序完成等效質量剛度與頻率、相近頻率的時窗選擇、低幅振型的可信度、應變測點方向、頻率與量具不確定度及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Identify ground-vibration modes using multi-point phase and test boundaries in a Synthetic impact, excitation and modal-data bench, progressing through Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency, Window selection for nearby frequencies, Confidence in low-amplitude mode shapes, Strain-sensor orientation, Frequency and instrumentation uncertainty, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察

steps.title: 等效質量剛度與頻率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 等效質量剛度與頻率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「飛機地面振動試驗」中，本單元處理「等效質量剛度與頻率」。單自由度頻率取決於剛度與質量比；改質量和改剛度會有不同的模態影響。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft ground-vibration testing, this unit examines Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency. A single-degree frequency depends on stiffness-to-mass ratio; changing mass and stiffness affects modes differently.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：等效剛度 k=40000 N/m、質量 m=10 kg。關係式 f=sqrt(k/m)/(2π)；含輸出單位換算的算式 sqrt(40000/10)/(2*pi)，結果 10.065842 Hz。適用範圍：單自由度無阻尼估算；複雜結構須用多點模態形狀。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Equivalent stiffness k=40000 N/m and mass m=10 kg. Relation f=sqrt(k/m)/(2π); evaluated expression including output-unit conversion sqrt(40000/10)/(2*pi) gives 10.065842 Hz. Applicability: Undamped single-degree estimate; complex structures require multi-point mode shapes.
steps.failure: 在「等效質量剛度與頻率」的情境中，感測器附加質量可降低輕結構頻率，需納入模型。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency, Sensor mass can lower a lightweight structure frequency and must be included.
steps.check: 針對「等效質量剛度與頻率」，對比兩個感測點相位與幅值，避免把局部附件頻率當整機模態。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency, Compare phase/amplitude at two sensors to distinguish an attachment mode from a global mode. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 m 改為16 kg，其餘條件固定。用 sqrt(40000/16)/(2*pi) 重算，結果從 10.065842 變成 7.9577472 Hz。先預測方向，再記下對「等效質量剛度與頻率」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only m to 16 kg, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate sqrt(40000/16)/(2*pi): 10.065842 becomes 7.9577472 Hz. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「飛機地面振動試驗」的「等效質量剛度與頻率：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「座艙模擬器：回應之前」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Equivalent mass, stiffness and frequency: Mechanism and observation” in “Aircraft ground-vibration testing”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Cockpit Simulator: Before the Response” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.objective: 辨識 激振和量測取樣配置 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Excitation and measurement sampling and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「飛機地面振動試驗」中，本單元處理「激振和量測取樣配置」。取樣的Nyquist上限只是必要條件，類比抗混疊和波形頻帶仍需確認。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft ground-vibration testing, this unit examines Excitation and measurement sampling. The Nyquist limit is necessary but insufficient; analog anti-aliasing and signal bandwidth still matter.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：取樣率 fs=1000 Hz。關係式 fN=fs/2；含輸出單位換算的算式 1000/2，結果 500 Hz。適用範圍：均勻取樣理想上限，不代表接近上限時幅相誤差可接受。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Sampling rate fs=1000 Hz. Relation fN=fs/2; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 1000/2 gives 500 Hz. Applicability: Ideal uniform-sampling ceiling; it does not guarantee acceptable amplitude/phase error near the limit.
steps.failure: 在「激振和量測取樣配置」的情境中，高於上限的真實振動可能變成低頻峰，造成錯誤故障定位。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Excitation and measurement sampling, A vibration above the limit can appear as a low-frequency peak and mislead diagnosis.

steps.checkEn: For Excitation and measurement sampling, Inject a synthetic high-frequency component, identify its alias and add an anti-aliasing illustration. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.
